== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 27 June 1721. The entry names John Glasgow and Agnes Ferguson as his parents.<ref>Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Irvine, Ayrshire, Old Parish Registers; indexed christening of John Glasgow, 27 June 1721, son of Agnes Ferguson.</ref> The existing father-profile assessment remains [[Glasgow-1077|John Glasgow MA]] at 98%; the prior link to [[Ferguson-15168|Agnes Ferguson]] is retained as an unassessed mother-profile candidate.

His sister [[Glasgow-4122|Sarah Glasgow]] was baptised at Irvine in 1726 to the same parents.
